query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ip_lockouts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  ipAddress VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  failedAttempts INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  lockedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  lockedUntil TIMESTAMP NULL,
  isLocked ENUM('true', 'false') DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL,
  lastAttemptAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
)
